gaps.sentence: I'm really looking forward to ___ you again soon.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: 'to' is a preposition here.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
The ministry tried to play ___ the incident.
gaps.explanation: play down = make something seem less important (opposite: play up).

gaps.sentence: The factory laid ___ two hundred workers.
gaps.explanation: lay off = dismiss workers because there is not enough work.

gaps.sentence: He loves showing ___ his new car to the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: show off = try to impress people with your abilities/possessions.

gaps.sentence: The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.

gaps.sentence: Looking back ___ it, the risk was worth taking.
gaps.explanation: look back ON something = remember and think about the past.

gaps.sentence: The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.
